labels: TEMPERATURE RANGE ANTICIPATED BEFORE NEXT OIL CHANGE

content.description: Illustration showing an oil pressure gauge connected to an engine via a hose adapter. Labeled LU0601.

items:
CHECK OIL QUALITY
Check the oil for deterioration, entry of water, discoloring or thinning.
If the quality is poor, change the oil.
Use API grade SF or SF/CC multigrade, fuel-efficient and recommended viscosity oil.

CHECK OIL LEVEL
The oil level should be between the L and F marks on the oil level gauge. If low, check for leakage and add oil up to the F mark.
REMOVE OIL PRESSURE SWITCH OR SENDER GAUGE

START ENGINE
Start engine and warm it up to normal operating temperature.

MEASURE OIL PRESSURE
Oil pressure:
At idle speed More than 0.3 kg/cm² (4.3 psi, 29 kPa)
At 3,000 rpm 2.5 — 5.0 kg/cm² (36 — 71 psi, 245 — 490 kPa)

content.text: NOTE: Check for oil leakage after reinstalling the oil pressure switch or sender gauge.
